label: scope5-all-hardening-tail
description: Authored positive convergence case. Rounds 1-2 carry plan_correctness findings (C1, C2) that are fixed before the next round, reaching the default threshold (3). Round 3 (== threshold) carries ONLY verification_hardening findings (C3, C4, C5) as the open blocking set, so the round lands accepted-with-debt: disposition accept_plan, and all three tail findings convert to deferred plan-review debt with originRound 3. This is the tail of the negotiation being all hardening: once no plan_correctness / round-forcing blocker remains past the threshold, the review lands rather than burning further rounds, and the hardening reservations are recorded as debt instead of dropped.
